<thought>From the ^13C NMR data, three distinct signals appear in the typical methyl carbon region (≈38–55 ppm): 52.24 ppm (likely an O‑CH₃), 43.47 ppm (likely an N‑CH₃), and 38.60 ppm (likely a carbonyl‑adjacent CH₃). Each distinct methyl carbon gives one signal, indicating three CH₃ groups in the molecule.</thought>
